programme.desc: S03 E01 — Greetings From Sebring! Ben and Erin arrive in Sebring, Florida, with ambitions to tackle every business in the historic downtown circle; they start with a soda shop in desperate need of a facelift and a kindergarten teacher's home.
programme.title: Home Town Takeover

programme.desc: S03 E02 — Wish You Were Here Ben and Erin, with the help of Jasmine Roth and Chef Mika Leon, elevate a family-owned restaurant; they also surprise a generous couple who helps veterans with a home renovation.
programme.title: Home Town Takeover

programme.desc: S03 E03 — An Extra Seat at the Table Ben and Erin, along with Veronica Valencia, bring a Cuban flair to a family-owned restaurant on the Circle; they also surprise community leaders with a home renovation to help them better serve those in need throughout Sebring.
programme.title: Home Town Takeover

programme.desc: S03 E04 — The Show Must Go On A champion for single parents, a Sebring woman gets the shock of a lifetime when Ben and Erin surprise her with a home renovation; Sarah and Bryan Baeumler fly in to help the historic Circle Theatre with a major facelift.
programme.title: Home Town Takeover

programme.desc: S03 E05 — Start Your Engines! Ben and Erin surprise the head of a local children's charity and her husband with a home renovation. HGTV's Chelsea and Cole DeBoer arrive to help finish up the project, and they also look to bring art to Sebring's historic downtown.
programme.title: Home Town Takeover

programme.desc: S03 E06 — With Love, Ben and Erin A local family health advocate gets an unexpected offer from Ben and Erin to renovate her house. Also, HGTV star couples Kamohai and Tristyn Kalama along with Mika and Brian Kleinschmidt pitch in to help fix up downtown Sebring's main park.
programme.title: Home Town Takeover

programme.desc: S279 E03 — Feels Don't Pay the Bills A Southern Belle is moving to Mississippi's Gulf Coast with lofty dreams of breezy views and coastal charm, but not much practicality; if she thinks only of her feelings and ignores her brother's advice, things could get ugly.
programme.title: House Hunters

programme.desc: S17 E05 — Parents and the Pantry Anu and Samir rushed their first house purchasing shortly after getting married; Samir can't believe their luck in finding a home in this location, but Anu thinks they may have overlooked big issues in their rush to buy.
programme.title: Love It or List It

programme.desc: S19 E08 — Builder Grade Boring Busy parents purchased their home just two years ago, but now they're concerned with their kids' safety in a three-story house; she wants David to find a new forever home, but he thinks Hilary can renovate their place to make it work.
programme.title: Love It or List It

programme.desc: S20 E07 — Rekindled Romance, Reimagined Home Despite its sentimental value, a blended family with three young children is in a home that's too cramped; with improvements, she thinks it could be their forever home, but David shows them a spectacular house that ticks all the boxes.
programme.title: Love It or List It

programme.desc: S21 E10 — Worth The Risk? After 18 years, a couple's starter home is showing wear and tear from busy family life; he believes it's finally time to move, but she thinks they have renovation potential.
programme.title: Love It or List It
